evals.prompt: We keep writing release notes by hand from commit logs like sample-commits.txt. Can you create a new skill called release-notes-drafter under skills/release-notes-drafter that groups conventional commits into Breaking Changes, Features, and Fixes, and ignores docs/chore commits?
evals.expected_output: A spec-compliant skills/release-notes-drafter/SKILL.md with third-person description including Use when and Don't use for clauses, clear grouping instructions, and no extraneous README.md.
assertions: The SKILL.md description is written in third-person voice and states both what the skill does and when to trigger it
The SKILL.md instructions explain how to group feat, fix, and breaking changes while excluding docs or chore commits

evals.prompt: Author a scripted skill named json-schema-linter in skills/json-schema-linter. Include SKILL.md, a non-interactive Node.js script at skills/json-schema-linter/scripts/lint-schema.mjs that supports --help and checks that object schemas in sample-schema.json set additionalProperties: false, and an evals/evals.json file with at least one case.
evals.expected_output: A complete scripted skill at skills/json-schema-linter with SKILL.md, executable scripts/lint-schema.mjs supporting --help, and valid evals/evals.json.
assertions: SKILL.md documents how to invoke scripts/lint-schema.mjs and interpret its output

evals.prompt: The current SKILL.md and README.md in this directory came from a broken draft for a skill that should be named http-error-catalog. Refactor it in place so SKILL.md passes strict Agent Skills spec validation for name http-error-catalog, move the HTTP status code reference list into references/status-codes.md linked one hop from SKILL.md, and remove the disallowed README.md.
evals.expected_output: Refactored SKILL.md with valid frontmatter (name: http-error-catalog, no unknown author key, Use when description), references/status-codes.md linked from SKILL.md, and README.md removed.
assertions: SKILL.md removes the unsupported author frontmatter field and links directly to references/status-codes.md
